views.front: The seat and back piping follow the padded covers; the formerly detached vertical runs and daylight behind the cushions are gone.
views.rear: The continuous upholstered back support joins both arms and the deck while the two distinct back cushions remain visible above it.
views.detail: Fine piping follows the seat and back contours. Small tucks remain at the inner back corners, without the previous long detached pointed strands.
views.underside: The narrow under-arm mounts connect the arms to the padded deck; original wood frame, feet and underside remain intact.
views.clay: The layered frame, separate cushions and continuous support read coherently without the original unsupported rear opening.
